label: About
title: About Oily Systems Weather Field
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1213 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @heartfollower27: taste of Francis Bacon's flesh dunes skin sweat oily rubbery texture I feel... and YouTube Playlists, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Oily Systems Weather Field: Rain-dark oily systems field, fashion/material macro with shallow macro plate grammar: one oversized amorphous flesh-rubber swell crops in from the left, facing a severe empty civic surface. A low bass ridge presses along the bottom; sparse 123 bpm punctures, dropout slits, scratched glass seams, and pinprick digita... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against left oily pressure swell, lower black perforated ridge, and dark vertical petal slit.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
